title: Floating Can Cost Astronauts 30% Of Hip-Bone Density
hook: Floating can cost astronauts 30% of hip-bone density.
closing: Weightlessness feels effortless, but an astronaut's skeleton keeps paying for it.
question: How much bone protection will a Mars mission require?

segments.say: An astronaut can lose 1.5% of bone density each month despite intensive exercise.
Hip-bone density can fall 2.2%, making the body's strongest supports unexpectedly vulnerable.
A Mars mission could cost 30% of hip-bone density without stronger protection.
